# Duration.TotalSeconds

```m
Duration.TotalSeconds(duration as nullable duration) as nullable number
```

Returns the total seconds spanned by `duration`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `duration` | `nullable duration` | no |
